result:
The expression is symmetric once expanded, so it can be computed directly from the given power sums.

Group the factors as (s+m+t)(s−m−t) = s² − (m+t)² and (s+m−t)(s−m+t) = s² − (m−t)². Then

(s² − (m+t)²)(s² − (m−t)²) = s⁴ − 2s²(m²+t²) + (m²−t²)² = s⁴ + m⁴ + t⁴ − 2(s²m² + s²t² + m²t²).

Let Q = s²m² + s²t² + m²t². Squaring the first equation gives 64 = (s²+m²+t²)² = (s⁴+m⁴+t⁴) + 2Q = 25 + 2Q, so Q = 39/2.

The expression therefore equals 25 − 2·(39/2) = 25 − 39 = −14.

None of the three solutions reaches this value:
- Solution 1 never finishes the computation and gives 875.
- Solution 2 correctly finds Q = 19.5 but then answers 39 instead of 25 − 39.
- Solution 3 guesses 12 without justification.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
